name: front-desk-review-pricing
title: The Front Desk Review — front-office software pricing
description: Independent, sourced pricing & capability data on front-office software (AI Receptionists, Call Tracking, Business Texting, Online Booking). Every figure carries its source URL and the date it was last verified.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Hub section slug the row belongs to (e.g. ai-receptionists).

fields.name: vendor_slug
fields.description: Stable URL-safe identifier for the vendor.

fields.name: vendor_name
fields.description: Vendor display name.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: Vendor primary domain.

fields.name: canonical_url
fields.description: Canonical on-site vendor profile URL.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: Plan name as published by the vendor.

fields.name: monthly_usd
fields.description: Base monthly price in USD (empty for quote-only tiers).

fields.name: minutes_included
fields.description: Talk-minutes included in the plan, if any.

fields.name: calls_included
fields.description: Calls included in the plan, if any.

fields.name: overage_per_min
fields.description: Marginal overage rate per minute beyond the included quota, in USD.

fields.name: overage_per_call
fields.description: Marginal overage rate per call beyond the included quota, in USD.

fields.name: annual_discount_pct
fields.description: Discount percentage for annual commitment, if published.

fields.name: setup_fee_usd
fields.description: One-time setup fee in USD, if any.

fields.name: billing_model
fields.description: Normalized billing model (flat, per_minute, per_call, per_seat, per_message, hybrid, custom).

fields.name: hipaa
fields.description: HIPAA support: yes / no / unknown.

fields.name: baa
fields.description: Business Associate Agreement availability: yes / no / unknown.

fields.name: bilingual
fields.description: Bilingual support: yes / no / unknown.

fields.name: integrations
fields.description: Named integrations, semicolon-separated.

fields.name: quote_only
fields.description: Whether the vendor publishes no usable per-plan price (yes / no).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Public source URL the figures on this row were captured from.

fields.name: accessed_at
fields.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the source was accessed.

fields.name: corroboration_url
fields.description: Second independent source URL corroborating the figures, if any.

fields.name: corroboration_accessed_at
fields.description: ISO date the corroborating source was accessed, if any.
